resourceType.why: what kind of object the row is, for a table that stores more than one kind

schemaVersion.why: the shape a stored row was written against, a property of the canonical schema rather than of each row

ownerAccount.why: the account the row belongs to, the value every isolation policy compares against

organization.why: the organization the row is scoped to, null for a personal row

workspace.why: the workspace the row is filed under, for a tenant that partitions its work

project.why: the project the row is filed under, null when it is loose

createdBy.why: the principal that created the row, which is not always its owner

updatedBy.why: the principal that last wrote the row

createdAt.why: when the row came into existence

updatedAt.why: when the row was last written

deletedAt.why: when the row was soft deleted, null while it is alive

archivedAt.why: when the row was archived, which hides it without deleting it

version.why: the optimistic-concurrency token an If-Match precondition quotes

visibility.why: who may read the row beyond its owner

retentionClass.why: how long the row is kept before a retention sweep removes it

source.why: what produced the row, for a table fed by more than one path

originSurface.why: which product surface produced the row

parent.why: the owning row, for a child object whose ownership is its parent's

gaps.why: a rename or a scope change rewrites the row and moves neither column, so the last write is unrecoverable.
gaps.fix: add updated_at with a before-update trigger, as the resource_row_timestamps migration did for organization_members.

gaps.why: three columns each record one transition and none of them records the most recent write.
gaps.fix: add updated_at with a before-update trigger.

gaps.why: an access-token refresh and the review toggle both rewrite the row without moving any timestamp.
gaps.fix: add updated_at with a before-update trigger.

gaps.why: a new asset version rewrites version and parent_version_id while the row records only its deletion.
gaps.fix: add updated_at with a before-update trigger.

gaps.why: a scope change rewrites the row and moves neither column, so the last write is unrecoverable.
gaps.fix: add updated_at with a before-update trigger, as the resource_row_timestamps migration did for organization_members.

gaps.why: recipients_notified and spent_cents are rewritten as the period runs and no column follows them.
gaps.fix: add updated_at with a before-update trigger.

gaps.why: the share row records only when the link dies, never who the link was meant for.
gaps.fix: add visibility alongside the token and have the share route read it, as published_artifacts does.

gaps.why: messages and total_messages grow after the share is created and no column records the growth.
gaps.fix: add updated_at with a before-update trigger.
